summary: Adds a new test checking that CompactSelectedSeries skips series with out-of-order data, keeps them in the head, and still compacts and evicts the other refs into one block. It only exercises production code and cannot change runtime behavior, so a line-by-line review can be skipped.
headline: New test: selected-series compaction skips series holding OOO data
reason: New test-only function that adds coverage and changes no production code or existing assertions.
